senses.gloss:
स्फोट स्फोट, i. e. स्फुट् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Bursting, breaking.
 2. A tumour, a boil, Suśr. 2, 383, 10.
 3. The eternal sound, in the Pūrva Mīmāṃsā.
 II. f. टा, The hood of the snake.
 --Comp.

स्फोटन स्फोटन, i. e. स्फुट् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Breaking, Pañc. 81, 8; [] tearing.
 2. Fidgeting with the hand, snapping the fingers.
 II. f. नी, A gimblet, an auger.
